ios.desc:
Love, read from the sky you were born under.

Totem is soulmate astrology made quiet and personal. Tell it when and where you were born, and it draws your birth chart in ink, then reads it the way a friend who knows the stars would: who you're drawn to, how you love, and what today's sky means for your heart.

A NOTE FOR YOUR HEART, EVERY MORNING
Each day starts with the real sky, calculated with Swiss Ephemeris, the same precision astrologers use. You get a short reading of what's moving in love today, an affirmation written for your rising sign, the Moon's phase and the week's key dates. The planet with the strongest story draws its true path across the sky, retrograde loops included.

YOUR SOULMATE READING
Your 7th house describes the person you're drawn to. Totem reads it from your chart: who they are, where you're likely to meet, and the windows when Venus moves through the houses that matter for love. Turn on reminders and you'll know when each window opens.

COMPATIBILITY
Add someone's birth date and see your two charts drawn together. Where you meet easily, where you grow, and the placements that make the two of you click.

THE ORACLE
Ask about love, timing or a person, or describe a dream. The Oracle reads it through your chart and today's sky, and answers once, in full: the placements behind it, what a dream's symbols mean for you, when things shift, and one line to keep.

LOVE LETTER
Turn your chart into a beautiful card to keep or share.

WIDGETS AND A DAILY NOTE
Put today's affirmation on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, keep the Moon's phase in view, and get a gentle daily notification at the time you choose.

No birth time? You can still use Totem. Your houses are read from your Sun sign until you add it.

TOTEM PRO
Free: your birth chart, the daily sky and affirmation, a first look at your Soulmate Reading and Compatibility, and 3 Oracle readings a week.
Pro unlocks your personal daily note, the full Soulmate Reading with your love windows and reminders, full Compatibility with anyone, and Oracle readings without the weekly limit.

Totem Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, available weekly, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store accoun
